d.ko: "Touhou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III" is a bullet hell shooting game with a distinctive, glamorous presentation style. It is the third game in the Touhou Makuka Sai series. The strange moon seems to hide a new conspiracy. Charge into the deep world on the eternal night!

d.zh: 「東方幕華祭永夜篇」是一款带有个性华丽演出风格的弹幕射击游戏，東方幕華祭系列的第三作。异常的月像似乎隐藏着新的阴谋，在停滞的夜晚朝向深邃的世界突进吧！
